title: Application Icons doesn't appear
author: Nishantdd
summary: This missing-icon report is already labeled duplicate and owned by the CmdPal maintainer who acknowledged the underlying icon-provider failure, so it should stay out of the dashboard’s active design queue.

judgment.rationale: The issue is explicitly labeled duplicate, assigned to the relevant maintainer, and already points at the canonical CmdPal icon-loss discussion rather than an unowned new bug.
evidence: Issue #49418 carries the duplicate label and is assigned to jiripolasek.
The GitHub duplicate bot pointed at issue #46267, "CmdPal missing icon".
jiripolasek commented that Windows sometimes starts failing when PowerToys asks for certain icons, which is a direct maintainer diagnosis of the same symptom class.
A later commenter confirmed the same behavior in v0.101.2282 and on dock icons as well, reinforcing that this is part of the broader CmdPal icon-loading problem.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep the issue tied to the existing CmdPal icon-loss work and avoid spinning up a parallel dashboard design from this duplicate report.

fix_assessment.rationale: This artifact should not propose a separate fix plan because the issue is already labeled duplicate and routed to the broader CmdPal icon-loading investigation.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette intermittently fails to show application icons, but the issue is already marked duplicate and owned inside the existing CmdPal icon investigation.
known_information: The report includes screenshots and a bug report ZIP.

inferences: This report is a symptom instance of a broader icon-retrieval problem rather than a standalone untriaged bug.

issue_context.analysis: The right dashboard state is duplicate_or_handled. The issue has owner and routing; what remains is code/PR work on the canonical icon pipeline, not another artifact-specific fix request.
